mapper.sql: select a.id, a.alert_no, a.contract_id, a.collateral_id, a.company_id, a.alert_type, a.alert_level, a.alert_title, a.alert_content, a.alert_date, a.trigger_condition, a.suggested_action, a.alert_status, a.handler_id, a.handle_time, a.handle_opinion, a.close_time, a.close_reason, a.reactivate_time, a.reactivate_reason, a.priority_level, a.expiry_date, a.auto_close_flag, a.notification_sent, a.escalation_level, a.related_alerts, a.risk_score, a.impact_assessment, a.mitigation_plan, a.follow_up_date, a.created_by, a.created_time, a.updated_by, a.updated_time, a.orgid, c.company_name, gc.contract_no, ci.collateral_name, h.staff_name as handler_name, u.staff_name as create_user_name from TBL_GUARANTEE_MONITORING_ALERT a left join TBL_COMPANY c on a.company_id = c.id left join TBL_GUARANTEE_CONTRACTS gc on a.contract_id = gc.id left join TBL_COLLATERAL_INFO ci on a.collateral_id = ci.id left join TBL_STAFF h on a.handler_id = h.id left join TBL_STAFF u on a.created_by = u.id
mapper.select: where a.contract_id = #{contractId} order by a.created_time desc
where a.collateral_id = #{collateralId} order by a.created_time desc
where a.company_id = #{companyId} order by a.created_time desc
where a.alert_type = #{alertType} order by a.created_time desc
where a.alert_level = #{alertLevel} order by a.created_time desc
where a.alert_status = #{alertStatus} order by a.created_time desc
where a.handler_id = #{handlerId} order by a.created_time desc
where a.alert_status = 'ACTIVE' and a.orgid = #{orgid} order by a.priority_level desc, a.created_time desc
where a.alert_level in ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') and a.alert_status = 'ACTIVE' and a.orgid = #{orgid} order by a.priority_level desc, a.created_time desc
where a.expiry_date is not null and a.expiry_date <= DATEADD(day, #{days}, GETDATE()) and a.alert_status = 'ACTIVE' and a.orgid = #{orgid} order by a.expiry_date asc
where a.follow_up_date is not null and a.follow_up_date <= GETDATE() and a.alert_status = 'ACTIVE' and a.orgid = #{orgid} order by a.follow_up_date asc

update TBL_GUARANTEE_MONITORING_ALERT set alert_status = 'CLOSED', close_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, close_reason = '自动关闭过期预警', updated_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where expiry_date < GETDATE() and alert_status = 'ACTIVE' and auto_close_flag = '1' and orgid = #{orgid}
mapper.select: select count(*) as total_count, sum(case when alert_status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end) as active_count, sum(case when alert_status = 'HANDLED' then 1 else 0 end) as handled_count, sum(case when alert_status = 'CLOSED' then 1 else 0 end) as closed_count, sum(case when alert_level in ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') and alert_status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end) as high_risk_count, sum(case when expiry_date is not null and expiry_date <= DATEADD(day, 7, GETDATE()) and alert_status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end) as expiring_count, sum(case when follow_up_date is not null and follow_up_date <= GETDATE() and alert_status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end) as follow_up_count, avg(case when risk_score is not null then risk_score else 0 end) as avg_risk_score from TBL_GUARANTEE_MONITORING_ALERT where orgid = #{orgid}

select CONVERT(varchar, alert_date, 23) as alert_date, count(*) as alert_count, sum(case when alert_level in ('HIGH', 'CRITICAL') then 1 else 0 end) as high_risk_count from TBL_GUARANTEE_MONITORING_ALERT where alert_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and orgid = #{orgid} group by CONVERT(varchar, alert_date, 23) order by alert_date

select alert_type, count(*) as count, sum(case when alert_status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end) as active_count from TBL_GUARANTEE_MONITORING_ALERT where orgid = #{orgid} group by alert_type order by count desc

select 'GA' + CONVERT(varchar, GETDATE(), 112) + RIGHT('000' + CAST(ISNULL(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(alert_no, 3) AS INT)), 0) + 1 AS VARCHAR), 3) from TBL_GUARANTEE_MONITORING_ALERT where alert_no like 'GA' + CONVERT(varchar, GETDATE(), 112) + '%'
